schedule.runMonth: Array of month names (e.g. 'January', 'June', 'December') to run backup. Empty array = every month.
schedule.runWeekday: Array of weekday names (e.g. 'Monday', 'Friday') to run backup. Empty array = every day.
schedule.runTime: Array of UTC times in HH:mm format when backup should run.
schedule.minIntervalMinutes: Minimum minutes between backup runs to prevent duplicate executions.

_comments.backupRoot: UNC path or local path to backup root directory. Hostname will be appended automatically.
_comments.credentialEnvVar: Name of Machine-level environment variable containing Base64-encoded 'username:password'
_comments.tempExportRoot: Local directory for temporary VM exports. Space is checked dynamically per VM (1.5x VM size).
_comments.retentionCount: Number of backup generations to keep (1-365). Older backups are automatically deleted.
_comments.excludeVMs: Array of VM names to exclude from backup process

options.dryRun: Simulate backup without actually exporting or copying VMs
